verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
Baptize my heart
With Your fire, desire

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
I don't want to be offended
I don't want to be offended
I don't want to be offended
When it's all coming down

verse.name: o1
verse.lines:
I want to be for You, not against You
I want to be with You where You are

verse.name: o2
verse.lines:
I pledge my allegiance to Jesus, to Jesus
I pledge my allegiance to the Lamb
